comment: All nine CV-fed parameters are read with getVoltage(), not getPolyVoltage(), so the module is monophonic despite the plugin's other modules being polyphonic. The manual's CV table states the four CV inputs are ±5V; the code applies no clamp to the jack itself, scaling volts by 0.1 through the attenuverter and clamping only the knob-plus-CV sum to the parameter's 0 to 1, so ±10V reaches the full range. The manual writes the fourth CV input as B DUR CV where the panel prints B WID; the maker's own port name is "Duration barrier CV" and the knob above it is "Frequency barrier width" — they are the same control, described from the duration side and the frequency side.
